messages:
Hannah Ito: Quick post-all-hands note to capture the Q&A thread on customer wins/losses + asks for leadership. Wanted to pin the top themes and next steps.

Luis Mercado: TL;DR from field: wins = burst reliability + clear billing; losses = no BYO-KMS in-customer-VPC and lack of a small on-prem reference for procurement.

Clara Zhou: Adding nuance: one loss was strictly timing  the prospect wanted audit-log export to their SIEM in the procurement window. They said "we'll pick whoever can demonstrate it in 2 weeks."

Samir Rao: Product question for Execs: do we want to publicly commit to BYO-KMS in VPC + audit export as a Q1 shipped item or label it "Q1 target"? This affects what Sales/CS can promise.

Luis Mercado: My recommendation: mark as Q1 commitment if we can reassign 1 infra engineer to unblock the two infra tickets. Otherwise set expectation "targeting Q1". Customers want firm dates.

DevOps-bot: Infra backlog summary: INF-975 (KMS proxy auth), INF-982 (audit-export durability), INF-989 (VPC onboarding automation). Status: triaged; ETA if prioritized: ~4-6 weeks.

Clara Zhou: Other asks surfaced: 1) a tiny air-gapped reference bundle (container + quickstart) for customers to test on-prem, 2) Console eval-gate (block rollouts on eval regressions), 3) recommended canary config + streaming best-practices doc.

Hannah Ito: Leadership asks: please confirm priority order and whether Execs will approve short-term headcount reallocation to push INF-975/982. Also request a 1-paragraph blurb from Eng for next all-hands to set expectations.

Samir Rao: I'll draft the blurb. Proposed text: "We're prioritizing customer-managed keys in VPC and audit export as top Q1 targets; ETA subject to infra prioritization. We will deliver a small on-prem reference and an eval-gate prototype shortly after." Thoughts?

Luis Mercado: That reads well. Sales request: a one-page "what we support today vs roadmap" we can hand to procurement teams. Need it by next Tue.

Clara Zhou: Ops can produce the minimal on-prem bundle spec; estimate 1-2 weeks for a demo artifact. DevEx asked to publish canary sample + prefix caching snippet this sprint.

DevOps-bot: Action items created: ACT-1321 (one-pager for Sales/CS), ACT-1322 (Eng infra comment + ETA on INF-975/982), ACT-1323 (on-prem reference spec), ACT-1324 (DevEx canary & streaming doc).

Hannah Ito: Captured. I'll compile into a short action tracker and post to #product once Eng/Infra replies.

Samir Rao: If anyone has anonymized customer wording we can put in the one-pager, paste here. Example from CS: "We picked the vendor that could hand us audit exports during procurement." Happy to scrub.

Luis Mercado: Adding: "Redwood's stability during our peak demo convinced our execs" (anonymized).

Clara Zhou: End of thread for now  will follow up with infra/eng responses and post updates in #product.

Hannah Ito: :thumbsup:
